image_description: A studio-style photograph featuring multiple cucumbers on a white background. There is one whole, long, curved cucumber in the foreground, a shorter whole cucumber in the mid-ground, and two cut sections (one showing the cross-section with seeds) arranged around them. The lighting creates soft shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated cylindrical fruit with smooth, thin green rind.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible surfaces of all cucumber pieces exhibit a smooth, thin green rind consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform dark to medium green coloration with slight waxy sheen.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is predominantly green with natural variations (lighter stripes on the mid-ground cucumber) and a distinct waxy specular highlight, matching the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small raised bumps or spines on surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Subtle textural irregularities resembling small bumps are visible on the skin of the foreground cucumber.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated cylindrical form with length substantially exceeding its diameter.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible pieces maintain a high aspect ratio typical of cucumbers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Straight or slightly curved shape with rounded ends.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground cucumber shows a natural curve; the cut ends are rounded/flat as expected for sliced produce.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Thin green rind covering pale green to white translucent flesh.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cut cross-section clearly displays the contrast between the dark green rind and the pale interior flesh.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cut cross-section reveals central seed cavity with small flat seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The cut piece in the bottom right clearly shows the internal structure with a defined seed cavity area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Seeds arranged in radial pattern within cavity.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The seeds in the cross-section appear to radiate from the center, consistent with botanical reality.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pale green to white translucent flesh surrounding seeds.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The flesh surrounding the seed cavity is pale and appears moist/translucent.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture on the large foreground cucumber appears slightly 'painted' or overly smooth in patches, lacking the micro-detail of real skin pores/bumps, though it retains general realism.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of cut cucumber pieces (bottom right)
artifact_observations.reasoning: The small cut piece at the very bottom right seems to merge slightly ambiguously with the shadow/background, and its geometry feels slightly flattened compared to the other pieces.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific variety and ensure no misclassification as zucchini or other gourds.
To verify the structural integrity of the cut faces and ensure seeds/flesh do not melt into the rind.
To assess the realism of the lighting, shadows, and surface textures for AI artifacts.

focus_areas: Internal seed structure realism in cut sections
Surface texture consistency (waxy sheen vs. plastic look)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the cut cross-sections. AI often fails to render the complex radial seed pattern correctly, resulting in mushy or non-radial seeds. Also, check if the 'waxy sheen' looks like natural moisture/reflection or artificial plastic gloss.
